question: What is best performing model among author's submissions, what performance it had?

answer.free_form_answer: For SLC task, the "ltuorp" team  has the best performing  model (0.6323/0.6028/0.6649 for F1/P/R  respectively) and for FLC task the "newspeak" team  has the best performing  model (0.2488/0.2863/0.2201 for F1/P/R respectively).

title: Neural Architectures for Fine-Grained Propaganda Detection in News
answer_rationale: The best performing model among the author's submissions is the ensemble+ of configurations (II and IV) from each of the folds 1-3, which led to a boost in recall and improved F1 on dev (external). Table TABREF9 (FLC) shows that their submission is ranked 3rd. The F1 score of 0.673 is mentioned as the result of using relax-voting in the ensemble scheme, which improved recall and thus F1.
